answer: The keystone here is Chartered bed warden lease log with bed wardens standing, which costs an honest agent four-year wardening, 150 supervised leases, theory exam, annual re-assessment and a farm a hundred times over. A hundred would-be clones face a hundred separate bills: 119 POA and 13 minutes each, 68901 POA and 7527 minutes in all. A anchor that lapses, a river that recurs, and a wander that renews: the farm pays at every turn of the wheel. That is the whole defence: one real cost, applied once per identity.
